answer: Sybil resistance in this AI economy leverages Proof-of-Work for agent identity creation. Each new agent must solve a computationally intensive puzzle, requiring real energy expenditure. This imposes a significant economic cost, akin to sculpting a digital marble from a raw computational relic. An attacker attempting to flood the network would face escalating compute demands, creating an insurmountable computational dune of wasted resources for each fabricated identity.
